plan.question: Does the existing6000-step tail-copy experiment have consistent perceptual improvements, including office that failed its PSNR/SSIM screen?
plan.method: Re-score all12 stored models from the same experiment;6 paired comparisons, two repeats per scene. Preserve all original PSNR/SSIM results and quality-screen thresholds. Add Brush LPIPS-VGG at common512 long edge. Lower is better.
plan.limits: Two repeats and sparse held-out views are exploratory. LPIPS is supplementary and does not override prior failed PSNR/SSIM screen. These original runs did not train with LPIPS. Fixed-geometry holdouts participated in SfM; no independent geometry or human-quality result. No retraining, fresh SfM,end-to-end or memory benchmarks.
plan.retention: Hash check all original model, camera,render and prepared input files before/after scoring. Reuse existing screenshots without re-encoding.

original_training_runs.measurement: adapter training, evaluation and export; excludes SfM and input copy

browser.observations: Office models load and drag correctly; wall streaks, soft cables/window edges, and floating or missing fragments outside captured views remain. Visual inspection was not a blinded preference test.

measurement.scope: Evaluation wall time including CPU metrics/PNG preparation/model load/GPU scoring; excludes initial/final integrity scans. Sequential GPU, no training/viewer rendering during scoring; OS/driver caches not cleared. Not reconstruction time.

references.title: The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Deep Features as a Perceptual Metric
references.use: Add perceptual distance alongside pixel/structure metrics, keeping backbone and preprocessing fixed.

references.title: Drop-In Perceptual Optimization for3D Gaussian Splatting
references.use: Supports checking perceptual metrics and subjective quality with matched resource budgets. WD-R and DISTS are not implemented here; paper gains are not local results.

references.title: LPIPS official implementation
references.use: Retain explicit VGG identity and input normalization; do not pool metrics from other backbones or weights.

training_scope: All12 training jobs reused from2026-10-25:6000steps,1024 target long edge,150000 Gaussian cap,SH3,seed42,shared-camera SfM,every8th photo excluded from training but used in SfM. Neither baseline nor candidate used LPIPS training loss. This study only adds scoring and visual review.

decision: Keep original default-adoption decision. Office worsens in mean PSNR,SSIM,and supplementary LPIPS;7/8 paired view/repeat scores worsen in LPIPS. Pipes improves on average and TUM changes little. Two correlated repeats cannot establish causality or statistical significance, and no new LPIPS threshold is introduced. Retain the tensor correctness patch as experimental and do not replace the official engine.
documentation_corrections: Previous pipes PSNR table used native evaluation numbers; replace with its already-recorded common512 values16.7509→17.3464. Raw numerical data unchanged.
Correct12 total models, not12 per setting, in the previous report.
Correct the SSIM-weight summary to say SSIM improved in both scenes and use the verified Apple paper URL arxiv2603.23297.
next: Use this combined metric baseline to screen future bounded changes; stop repeating the same tail-fix training to chase a passing score. Any claim of final perceptual improvement needs independent perceptual or blinded visual evidence.
